title: Popular TV-tracking app TV Time is shutting down as company focuses on AI
slides: What happens to your watch history when TV Time dies?
The app transitions users to an AI-driven platform.
Your data will not be wiped — but it will be repurposed.
You can export your logs before the switch closes.
Back up your lists now or lose them forever.
thread_text:
Your TV Time is dying.

The app is shutting down its old interface. Your watch history stays, but it is being moved to an AI-powered system with no opt-out.

Your data survives, but not as you know it.

The company will repurpose your logs for machine learning models. Privacy controls may not survive the transition.

You can still export everything.
A manual export option is open for a limited window. After that, your logs become part of the training set permanently.

Your curated lists are at risk.
The AI platform may not import your custom categories. Favorite shows and rankings you built could vanish.

Back up your lists right now.
Open the app today, locate the export button, and save your CSV. If you wait past the deadline, those lists are gone for good.

instagram.caption:
Your TV Time watch history is being turned into AI training data — with no way to stop it.

The app is shutting down its current interface and shifting everything to an AI-driven platform. You can still export your logs manually, but only for a limited window. After that, your curated lists and custom categories may vanish or become permanent training material.

If you track shows or rank episodes for work or personal reviews, your saved structure could be lost. The new system may not import your categories 🗂️.

Open the app now, find the export button, and save your CSV file 📥. Miss the deadline, and those lists are gone for good ⏳.

What’s your plan: export today or let your data train the next model?
